comment: Judgment calls for the SVG document. SVG has no attribute index comparable to WHATWG's, so keyword lists for SVGAnimatedEnumeration attributes and the value types of presentation attributes (CSS properties) come from here; they were seeded from the hand-curated specs/svg.json. Entries with "pending" name the machine-readable source that could replace them ("webref-css": @webref/css property value syntax).

aria.reason: aria-* attributes (WAI-ARIA) are not listed by browser-compat-data's SVG globals; modelled as a prefix like data-*.

class.reason: Set of space-separated class names; IDL exposes SVGAnimatedString className.

fill.reason: Presentation attribute (paint); browser-compat-data lists fill per element only, so it would otherwise be missing from shapes it does not list. Animation elements override it with freeze/remove.
